description: The bar chart illustrates the performance (accuracy) of three audio-language models on two benchmarks, MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR, shown as paired bars per model. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model names in left-to-right order: “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” with no explicit sorting indicator beyond this displayed order. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with regularly spaced tick marks at 10-percentage-point intervals. For each model, two adjacent bars are shown: the MMAU bar is colored blue and the MMAR bar is colored purple, as indicated by the legend in the upper-left. For “Qwen2-Audio-Instruct,” the blue MMAU bar reaches just under 50% (approximately 49%), and the purple MMAR bar is at about 30%. For “Audio-Reasoner,” the blue MMAU bar is a little above 60% (approximately 61%), and the purple MMAR bar is in the mid-30% range (approximately 36–37%). For “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” the blue MMAU bar is in the mid-60% range (approximately 65%), and the purple MMAR bar is in the mid-to-high 50% range (approximately 56–57%). The bars are grouped by model with side-by-side (not stacked) benchmark bars, and no individual bars appear visually emphasized with outlines, shading, or annotations.
